name: Google Gemini API
summary: Direct Google Developer API with project-scoped Free Tier or paid billing; no consumer-subscription API entitlement is inferred.

credentials.label: Gemini API key
credentials.help: Use your own Google AI Studio project key. Do not enter a Google account password.

setupSteps.title: Open AI Studio
setupSteps.description: Choose an existing eligible Google project and create your own Gemini API key manually.

setupSteps.title: Check project billing and limits
setupSteps.description: Check the active tier and model availability. Several keys in one project share limits; a consumer subscription is not proof of API credit.

setupSteps.title: Add the direct compatibility route
setupSteps.description: Use the Gemini API key and the exact v1beta/openai base URL. Keep paid fallback disabled unless deliberately configured.
